subject: English
passage: According to Chiamaka Uzoma of the Institute of Marine Biology, the reason certain deep-sea jellyfish can produce their own light while ______ is that their specialized cells contain luciferin compounds, enabling the organisms to illuminate themselves effectively for communication and predator deterrence.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The word "swimming" occurs in the middle of a clause and isn't part of a supplement, so we don't need any punctuation after it. We can see this more clearly if we simplify the rest of the sentence: "The reason jellyfish can produce light while swimming is that their cells contain luciferin compounds."
